title: Multi-tenant SaaS CRM
summary: Design a portable PostgreSQL 16 CRM for strict tenant isolation, core full-text search, dashboard latency, audit retention, and operationally boring growth.
critical_queries: Tenant dashboard account and open deal summary under p95 200ms.
Pipeline by stage for one tenant.
Recently touched contacts for the tenant landing page.
Upcoming activities assigned to one user.
Full-text note search scoped to one tenant.
Deal detail with account, primary contact, latest note, and activity counts.
Custom-field filter on accounts with bounded JSONB usage.
Append audit event and inspect recent audit history.
Tenant admin membership and role review.
Retention candidate query for audit event partition maintenance.

security_posture.tenant_isolation: strict RLS in a single database and schema

operational_notes: The design must stay portable to managed PostgreSQL such as Heroku Postgres or RDS, avoid exotic dependencies, explain audit retention, and keep dashboard reads observable with pg_stat_statements.
